name: Instruction learning loop
description: Each week, find review corrections that repeat across pull requests and propose short, cited additions or removals in the repository's agent instructions for a human to approve.

reviewBeforeSaving.note: Choose the repositories whose pull request discussions and instruction files should be read. Without one the run has nothing to learn from.
Runs at 08:00 UTC every Monday. Change the day or time, or turn the schedule off to run it only on demand.
Starts as Dry run, so a run only writes the report. Raise it to Preview & approve (recommended) to let the acting step create one ProPR task whose PR applies the approved instruction changes.
Needs Claude Code or Codex (or a synthetic pool of them), because the run reads pull request discussions through ProPR's MCP tools.
